It is not for publication. ::: The fruit of one tree in one season. ## Depends on - [tree](../1-soil/tree.mdx) · layer 1 · soil · 4 references ## Used by No block depends on this one. ## Entities ### Harvest Identified by `harvest_id` (`HarvestId`). | field | type | |---|---| | `tree_id` | `TreeId` | | `started_at` | `timestamp` | Relations: - `tree_id` references **Tree** of [tree](../1-soil/tree.mdx) (one, by `tree_id`) ## Commands ### RetireHarvest **Retire a harvest.** | field | type | |---|---| | `harvest_id` | `HarvestId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `no-such-harvest` (refused) | no such Harvest | `HarvestNotFound`: No harvest of this identity exists. | | `retired` | otherwise | moves the **Harvest** `Active` → `Retired`; emits `HarvestRetired` | | `wrong-state` (refused) | the Harvest is in a state that does not allow it | `HarvestStateConflict`: The harvest is not in a state this command acts from. | ### StartHarvest **Start a harvest.** | field | type | |---|---| | `harvest_id` | `HarvestId` | | `tree_id` | `TreeId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `started` | otherwise | creates a **Harvest** in `Active`; emits `HarvestStarted` | ## Events | event | fields | emitted by | |---|---|---| | `HarvestRetired` | `harvest_id` HarvestId, `at` timestamp | `RetireHarvest` | | `HarvestStarted` | `harvest_id` HarvestId, `at` timestamp | `StartHarvest` | ## Views | view | rows | fields | |---|---|---| | `Harvests`
